changed_family: audit-complete history and boundary publication for the already-frozen swing, structure and BOS semantics

bos_audit_amendments.attempt_history: retain every admitted real-completed wick-attempt clock in strict chronological order; attempt_count equals the length and last_attempt_at equals the final element
bos_audit_amendments.confirmed_resolution_order: every retained wick-attempt clock is strictly before a CONFIRMED resolved_at clock
bos_audit_amendments.failed_resolution_order: a FAILED state may have its final wick-attempt at resolved_at only when the same admitted candle supersedes or invalidates the prior pending thesis
bos_audit_amendments.boundary_terminal_publication: every pending BOS is emitted once as a typed FAILED state in the boundary-clock FrameObservation before tracker state is cleared; event memory is supplementary rather than a substitute
bos_audit_amendments.simultaneous_gap_and_contract_change: publish one terminal state per pending BOS with contract_change_reset as the deterministic reason, retain both reader anomaly codes, and increment reset_epoch once
bos_audit_amendments.post_boundary_visibility: typed boundary terminal states are visible only at the boundary decision clock; their immutable event details remain in bounded causal event memory afterward

blind_review_amendments.eligibility: Pass1 may select a case only when all four causal histories are non-empty, contract-consistent and contain the focal swing, pending clock, every attempt clock and resolved clock needed for exact Pass2 materialization
blind_review_amendments.enumeration: authority and reviewer each enumerate every raw-recoverable swing and BOS candidate at the case clock; a hidden focal-only comparison is forbidden
blind_review_amendments.selection_authority: review export, global review lock, truth overlay and scorecard bind the exact preregistered selection authority and Pass2 case commitments
blind_review_amendments.review_revalidation: every actual review document is schema-, identity-, attestation-, index-, issue-code- and action-language-validated again before truth
blind_review_amendments.strict_scorecard: missing, extra or uncertain swing/BOS candidates are strict disagreement; omission counts and MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_OMITTED are computed from immutable sequences
blind_review_amendments.path_isolation: review, export, truth and scorecard destinations must be disjoint from immutable packet, blind-set, review and authority transaction trees

unchanged_attestation: No swing relation, structure lifecycle, BOS confirmation threshold, playbook, decision, risk, execution, future-path or economic rule is changed by R2.
